description: CORRECTED Test data for creating orders - POST /api/order
note: Do NOT include 'price' field in detail items - let the backend calculate from product DB

corrected_usage.title: How to use this API correctly
rules: ✅ DO: Only send product, quantity, size, color in detail items
✅ DO: Backend will fetch product price & discount from DB and calculate total
❌ DON'T: Send 'price' field unless you want to override DB prices
❌ DON'T: Try to calculate prices yourself - let backend do it

simple_order_example.description: Recommended way to create an order
simple_order_example.what_happens: Backend will fetch each product's price and discount from DB, then calculate: price * (1 - discount%) * quantity for each item

order_with_percentage_discount.description: Order with 10% coupon discount on total
order_with_percentage_discount.calculation: subTotal = sum of all (productPrice * (1-productDiscount%) * qty), then totalPrice = (subTotal - 10%) + shipping + tax

minimal_order.note: shippingPrice, taxPrice, discount will default to 0

detail.discountProduct: Product's discount % at time of order (from DB)

expected_response_structure.subTotal: Sum of all detail[].totalPrice (after product discounts)

step2_subtotal.formula: Sum of all detail[].totalPrice (after product discounts)
step2_subtotal.note: This is AFTER individual product discounts are applied

step3_order_total_with_percentage_discou.note: Order-level discount applied on top of product discounts

step4_order_total_with_fixed_discount.note: Fixed amount discount on top of product discounts

important_notes: Product discount (discountProduct) is fetched from Product DB and stored in order detail
Each detail item stores: discountProduct %, price (before discount), totalPrice (after discount)
subTotal = sum of all detail[].totalPrice (after product discounts)
Order discount (percent/amount) is applied ON TOP of product discounts
Cannot use both discount.percent and discount.amount at the same time
You only need to send: product, quantity, size, color - prices are calculated automatically
